scope: Interim twelve-case tuning matrix, reused to guide training; not final held-out acceptance.
recommendation: Target early/middle-flight rear-foot transitions on nosing and reduce descent current leg-contact; compare reward branches on the same matrix without claiming final validation.

metrics_scope.means: Arithmetic means of three seed-level aggregate metrics, not sample-pooled RMS. Current/history foot-contact denominators differ and are explicitly recorded.
metrics_scope.leg_contact: Any calf/thigh/shank net normal force vector norm>1N at current policy boundary, or three5ms history samples for legacy. Neither is exact scraping duration.
metrics_scope.slip: Current/history-contact-gated worldXY foot-link speed>0.1m/s; both proxies, not contact-point tangential slip.
metrics_scope.history: 5msphysics/20mspolicy/history3 samples T,T-.005,T-.010; oldestage.010 nominalcountwindow.015; firstsubstep-only contact can be lost.
metrics_scope.endpoint: Last valid first episode before reset/classification; positions locate incomplete placement but do not establish collision causes.

contact_sampling.history_count_window_definition: history_length times sample interval; distinct from oldest sample age
contact_sampling.cadence_evidence: inferred from instantiated config and scene stepping; runtime sensor timestamps were not measured
contact_sampling.history_limit: history peaks can miss contacts outside the retained samples; reset rows start with zero history
contact_sampling.current_sample_scope: latest sensor force at the policy boundary before auto-reset; no substep duration inference
contact_sampling.force_measure: world-frame vector norm of net normal force, including riser normals; no tangential friction force
contact_sampling.slip_velocity_measure: foot-link world-horizontal speed at the policy boundary; not contact-point tangential slip
contact_sampling.legacy_results: reports without this metadata keep their original sampling semantics and cannot be assumed to use physics-step history
